column1: # Bed description for the endurance test. One row per slot.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Loaded by utils.sh:bed_load and consumed by the 01/02/04/07 step scripts.
#   slot         zero-based slot index (matches dut_$i during flashing)
#   jlink_host   JLink-IP DNS name (port 4902 control, 5901 SWD)
#   role         zniffer | controller | switch | door_lock | pir
#   bootloader   filename under ${artifacts}/; '-' if the firmware ships
#   route        PRIORITY_ROUTE_SET hex string; '-' for zniffer/controller
